title: 第七章 迈向伟大的开始第八章 哪怕是个邪修也要邪的顶天立地
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了
content_zh:

这一刻，仿佛天降仙音。
这声音，响起在赢商的心灵上，正是来自让他恢复年少的那块神秘的仙门社稷令，赢商眼中，顿时亮起。
“三刀，你真的愿意，将你的修炼所得，送给我吗？”
“那是当然！”
浪三刀重重点头，声若洪钟，满目赤诚道：“若非大哥你，我早就横死在街头了，更不要说你还带我进仙门，多活了这几百年。不要说修炼所得，就是修道天赋，我也愿意送给你！”
“哈哈，好极了，你放心，大哥永远不会亏待你的！”
赢商大笑。
乐开了花，重重拍了拍浪三刀的肩膀。
浪三刀这个憨憨看的愣愣，仿佛看神经病一般，有些无语。
他虽然这么说，也是真心的，但总归没办法真的送出，所以——赢商有什么好激动的呢？
……
轰！
大门在浪三刀出去之后，轰然关闭，灰色的雾气，弥漫起了门上，隔绝开门内门外两个世界。
赢商探手在自己手上的一枚银色戒指上一拂，再次取出了仙门社稷令。
握着此宝，赢商目光兴奋。仙门社稷令的一大玄妙，就是能够得到其他修士的修道心得和天赋，但需要与对方羁绊够深，并且对方自愿才行。在自愿的前提下，羁绊越深，成功几率越高，否则就要靠第四重玄妙，来强行掠夺，不过这一重玄妙至高至深，赢商还远远没资格开启。
而对方的灵根之身，如果与自己不同，更能直接开启第二灵根资质，整个过程，会暂时让对方进入虚弱状态，尤其天赋的威力会减弱，但随着修炼，会再次回到圆满状态。
浪三刀成了第一个贡献者，果然是好兄弟！
赢商自己是个冰修，浪三刀是金修，这个忠心耿耿的小弟，肉身资质，只是中上，但在金行上的悟性，却连二人的师傅，上一任的老宗门都惊叹，是天生的霸道金修！
“接受！”

赢商开口。
下一刻，赢商身躯立刻颤抖起来，只感觉一股无法形容的，高高在上，神秘莫测的力量，通过仙门社稷令，灌注进了自己的身躯里，改造起了自己的肉身，更有一股子锋利霸道的金行之道上的感悟，冲击进了脑海之中。
清晰！
纯粹！
美妙感觉，无法形容！
……
“浪三刀已经感悟成独门天赋——怒火霸刀，暴怒状态下，金行法术的威力，成倍暴增，怒火越盛，威力越狂！主人是否接受，让怒火霸刀，进驻你的天宠十二宫？”
没片刻之后，金行上的异常结束，而宝灵声音又起。
赢商乐了！
差点忘了，浪三刀这个老兄弟，也感悟成了一门独门天赋。
不过，那神秘的十三宫不算，他总共只有十二宫来进驻，真的要接受这门怒火霸刀吗？以后碰上更好的怎么办？
赢商问出这个问题。
“这一点，主人不必担心，将来碰上更好的，可以替换，不过被替换下的独门天赋的效果，将彻底消失。除此之外，没有其他损失。”
这个行！

At this moment, it was like a fairy sound descending from heaven.
This voice resounded in Ying Shang's heart, and it came from the mysterious Immortal Sect Order that restored his youth. Ying Shang's eyes suddenly lit up.
"Sandao, are you really willing to give me what you have gained from your cultivation?"
"Of course!"
Lang Sandao nodded heavily, his voice was like a bell, and he said with sincerity: "If it weren't for you, brother, I would have died on the street long ago, let alone you brought me into the immortal sect and lived for hundreds of more years. Not to mention the income from cultivation, even the talent of cultivation, I am also willing to give it to you!"
"Haha, great, don't worry, big brother will never treat you badly!"
The winning businessman laughed.
Overjoyed, he patted Lang Sandao heavily on the shoulder.
The fool Lang Sandao looked at him blankly, as if he was mentally ill, and was a little speechless.
Although he said this sincerely, he couldn't really give it away, so - what's so exciting about Yingshang?
…
Boom!
After Lang San Dao exited, the door slammed shut. Gray mist filled the door, isolating the two worlds inside and outside the door.
Yingshang Tan flicked his hand on a silver ring and took out the Xianmen Sheji Order again.
Holding this treasure, Yingshang's eyes were excited. One of the mysteries of the Xianmen Sheji Order is that it can obtain the cultivation experience and talents of other monks, but only if the bond with the other monk is deep enough and the other party is willing. Under the premise of voluntariness, the deeper the bond, the higher the chance of success. Otherwise, you have to rely on the fourth level of mystery to rob it by force. However, this level of mystery is so high and deep that Yingshang is far from qualified to open it.
And if the opponent's spiritual root body is different from your own, it can directly open the second spiritual root qualification. The whole process will temporarily put the opponent into a weak state, especially the power of the talent will be weakened, but with practice, it will return to the perfect state again.
Lang Sandao became the first contributor, and he was indeed a good brother!
Ying Shang himself is an ice cultivator, and Lang Sandao is a gold cultivator. This loyal younger brother's physical qualifications are only above average, but his understanding of the metal arts is such that even their masters and the previous sect were amazed. He is a born domineering gold cultivator!
"Accept!"
Winner spoke.
The next moment, Ying Shang's body immediately trembled. He only felt an indescribable, high and mysterious power, poured into his body through the Immortal Sect's Order, transforming his body, and a sharp and domineering understanding of the golden path entered his mind.
Clear!
purely!
Wonderful feeling, indescribable!
…
"Lang Sandao has become a unique talent - the Wrath Sword. In the state of rage, the power of the golden spell increases exponentially. The stronger the anger, the crazier the power! Will the master accept it, and let the Wrath Sword be stationed in your twelve palaces of heavenly favor?"
Not a moment later, the abnormality on the golden line ended, and Baoling's voice started again.
Happy business success!
I almost forgot that the old brother Lang Sandao also realized that he had a unique talent.
However, not counting the mysterious Thirteenth Palace, he only has the Twelfth Palace to station in. Does he really want to accept this angry sword? What should I do if I encounter something better in the future?
Winner asked this question.
"Master does not have to worry about this. If you encounter a better one in the future, you can replace it, but the effect of the unique talent being replaced will completely disappear. Other than that, there is no other loss."
This works!
